We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

As a (Senior) Product Manager at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS environment.

  • You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes.

  • You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories.

  • You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products.

  • You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business.

  • You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers.

  • You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements.

  • You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools.

  • You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools.

  • You have experience working with CRM systems.

💡It’s a Plus If You Have

  • Previous experience in the logistics industry.

We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way.

title: Head of Data Protection (m/f/d)
description: At Quantum Systems, we develop advanced autonomous systems for defence and security across multiple domains, combining unmanned platforms with integrated software and AI. As Head of Data Protection, you will play a key role in building and strengthening Quantum Systems’ Group-wide Data Protection Management System (DPMS). You will develop the Group privacy framework and coordinate its implementation and continuous improvement across our international entities, translating legal and technical requirements into pragmatic processes and controls. This is a leadership role with responsibility for developing the Group privacy framework and coordinating its implementation across the Group. As part of the integrated Governance, Risk & Compliance organization, you will work across corporate functions, entity management, business process owners, external Data Protection Officers (DPOs) and local privacy coordinators. Entity management and business process owners retain their respective responsibilities for compliance and operational implementation. DPOs retain their independent advisory and monitoring functions. What is your Day to Day Mission: Develop and continuously enhance the Group privacy framework, translating GDPR and international privacy requirements into clear governance, responsibilities, processes and standards, and coordinate implementation with local entities. Coordinate the Group-wide implementation and continuous improvement of the DPMS, consolidating privacy risks, remediation actions and implementation evidence and tracking outstanding measures with the responsible owners. Support business functions in establishing practical privacy processes, including data subject rights and incident response, and assess technical and organizational measures, IT architectures, cloud services and international data flows in collaboration with IT and Information Security. Coordinate external DPOs and local privacy coordinators, working closely with entity management, business process owners, GRC, Legal, HR, IT and Information Security, and support engagement with regulators and auditors within the relevant responsibilities. Report material privacy risks, outstanding actions and implementation progress to Group management, providing clear, decision-relevant information while preserving management accountability and the independent advisory and monitoring functions of DPOs. What you bring to the team: Several years of relevant experience in data protection or privacy management, with proven experience establishing and implementing privacy management systems in international organizations. Strong legal expertise in GDPR and international privacy requirements; qualification as a lawyer and a recognized Data Protection Officer certification are highly desirable. Strong technical privacy competence, including the ability to assess technical and organizational measures, IT architectures, cloud services and international data flows in collaboration with IT and Information Security. Strong analytical and implementation capabilities, with a proven ability to translate complex legal and technical requirements into pragmatic, scalable processes, effective controls and documented implementation evidence. Strong project and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional stakeholders without direct reporting lines and communicate clearly with business functions and senior management. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop, produce and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions designed for mission-critical operations in complex environments. Our systems combine autonomous platforms, advanced sensors, secure communications, mission software and AI to deliver actionable information, enable faster decision-making and support operations across domains – from the air to the ground and at sea. Headquartered in Gilching near Munich, with locations across Europe and worldwide, Quantum Systems develops its core technologies in-house. This integrated approach enables us to rapidly innovate, scale and deliver mission-ready solutions while strengthening European technological sovereignty. Quantum Systems operates in the global dual-use market, serving armed forces, security organizations, public institutions, and industrial and infrastructure customers. Our systems support a broad range of missions, including intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR), situational awareness, critical infrastructure protection and complex multi-domain operations. What sets us apart is the combination of hardware, software and AI within one integrated ecosystem - built to connect systems, data and operators across domains. Our mission is clear: Accelerate the world’s transition to unmanned systems for a better future. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Founder's Associate Intern
description: Als Founders Associate Intern arbeitest du direkt an der Seite des Founding Teams und bist in die wichtigsten strategischen und operativen Themen eingebunden. Du entwickelst neue Ideen und Geschäftsansätze mit und bringst sie hands-on in die Umsetzung. Dabei übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung, treibst eigene Projekte voran und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen konkrete Ergebnisse werden. Neben Business Development und Business Operations bist du auch im Daily Business eng eingebunden und koordinierst wichtige Schnittstellen zu Investoren, Banken und weiteren Stakeholdern. Wir suchen bewusst keine klassische Praktikantin bzw. keinen klassischen Praktikanten, sondern jemanden mit Entrepreneurial Mindset und echtem Drive, der Lust hat, ein Unternehmen von Anfang an mit aufzubauen. Die Rolle ist dabei mehr als ein Praktikum: Unser Ziel ist es, die Person im Anschluss idealerweise als ersten Full-Time Hire langfristig ins Team zu holen. Worum es geht Die Energiewende braucht Kapital. Gleichzeitig wächst in Deutschland der Markt für Erneuerbare-Energie-Projekte – doch die passende Finanzierung kommt noch viel zu selten effizient zustande. Was bislang fehlt, ist ein Tech-Layer, der Investoren, Projektentwickler und Banken intelligent miteinander verbindet. Wir glauben, dass darin enormes Potenzial steckt. Deshalb arbeiten wir aktuell im Stealth Mode an einer neuen Lösung, die genau hier ansetzt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und die Entwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten. Mehr über unsere Vision und das, woran wir arbeiten, erzählen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch. Was du in den 6 Monaten machst Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit besteht darin, das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen zu halten, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben und dafür zu sorgen, dass wir als Unternehmen immer schneller werden. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit dem Founding Team an strategischen Fragestellungen und entwickelst die Hypothesen mit, die unsere Richtung und unser Wachstum bestimmen. Operations: Du steuerst den Prozess mit Investoren von der ersten Anfrage bis zum Finanzierungsabschluss. Dabei koordinierst du die dazugehörigen Prozesse und entwickelst unsere operativen Abläufe weiter. Strategie: Gemeinsam mit dem Founding Team entwickelst du unsere Unternehmensstrategie weiter und baust das Finanzmodell auf, mit dem wir unser Wachstum planen und steuern. AI und Automatisierung: Du baust mit AI und No-Code-Tools, automatisierst Prozesse und bringst unsere Plattform auf das nächste Level. Go-to-Market: Du arbeitest aktiv an unserem Markteintritt mit, identifizierst potenzielle Partner und baust Beziehungen zu Banken und anderen Finanzierern auf. Was du mitbringst Idealerweise hast du deinen Bachelor oder Master abgeschlossen oder bist kurz vor dem Abschluss. Das ist aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Erste Praktika in Start-ups, Beratung oder Venture Capital. Erfahrung in Finance oder im Bereich erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus. Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Probleme und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand die Lösung vorgibt. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools und setzt neue Tools direkt in deiner Arbeit ein. Du triffst Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und stehst für das Ergebnis ein. Die Energiewende interessiert dich. Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch Eher nicht passend, wenn ... du suchst ein klassisches Praktikum mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben und festen Routinen. du fühlst dich wohler mit klaren Vorgaben, statt eigene Lösungen zu entwickeln. du lieber auf Freigaben wartest, als selbst anzufangen. dich Rückschläge schnell aus der Bahn werfen. In einem frühen Unternehmen läuft vieles nicht beim ersten Mal, und Probleme landen oft ungefiltert auf dem Tisch. du den ganzen Tag nur an der großen Strategie feilen willst. Der Alltag in der Early Stage besteht zum Großteil aus Umsetzung, auch bei den Gründern. Was wir bieten Option auf Übernahme nach den 6 Monaten Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club Du bist bei den wichtigen Entscheidungen dabei, auch in Bank- und Investorengesprächen. Wir glauben, dass darin enormes Potenzial steckt. Deshalb arbeiten wir aktuell im Stealth Mode an einer neuen Lösung, die genau hier ansetzt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und die Entwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten. Mehr über unsere Vision und das, woran wir arbeiten, erzählen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch.

Was du in den 6 Monaten machst

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit besteht darin, das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen zu halten, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben und dafür zu sorgen, dass wir als Unternehmen immer schneller werden. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit dem Founding Team an strategischen Fragestellungen und entwickelst die Hypothesen mit, die unsere Richtung und unser Wachstum bestimmen.

  • Operations: Du steuerst den Prozess mit Investoren von der ersten Anfrage bis zum Finanzierungsabschluss. Dabei koordinierst du die dazugehörigen Prozesse und entwickelst unsere operativen Abläufe weiter.

  • Strategie: Gemeinsam mit dem Founding Team entwickelst du unsere Unternehmensstrategie weiter und baust das Finanzmodell auf, mit dem wir unser Wachstum planen und steuern.

  • AI und Automatisierung: Du baust mit AI und No-Code-Tools, automatisierst Prozesse und bringst unsere Plattform auf das nächste Level.

  • Go-to-Market: Du arbeitest aktiv an unserem Markteintritt mit, identifizierst potenzielle Partner und baust Beziehungen zu Banken und anderen Finanzierern auf.

Was du mitbringst

  • Idealerweise hast du deinen Bachelor oder Master abgeschlossen oder bist kurz vor dem Abschluss. Das ist aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

  • Erste Praktika in Start-ups, Beratung oder Venture Capital.

  • Erfahrung in Finance oder im Bereich erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Probleme und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand die Lösung vorgibt.

  • Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools und setzt neue Tools direkt in deiner Arbeit ein.

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen auch dann, wenn nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und stehst für das Ergebnis ein.

  • Die Energiewende interessiert dich.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch

Eher nicht passend, wenn ...

  • du suchst ein klassisches Praktikum mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben und festen Routinen.

  • du fühlst dich wohler mit klaren Vorgaben, statt eigene Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • du lieber auf Freigaben wartest, als selbst anzufangen.

  • dich Rückschläge schnell aus der Bahn werfen. In einem frühen Unternehmen läuft vieles nicht beim ersten Mal, und Probleme landen oft ungefiltert auf dem Tisch.

  • du den ganzen Tag nur an der großen Strategie feilen willst. Der Alltag in der Early Stage besteht zum Großteil aus Umsetzung, auch bei den Gründern.

Was wir bieten

  • Option auf Übernahme nach den 6 Monaten

  • Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club

  • Du bist bei den wichtigen Entscheidungen dabei, auch in Bank- und Investorengesprächen.

  • Eigene Projekte, für die du verantwortlich bist und deren Ergebnis du direkt siehst

  • Eine steile Lernkurve an der Schnittstelle von Finance, Energie und AI

title: QA Engineer - Payments
description: <p>SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes</li> <li>Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.</li> <li>Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff</li> <li>Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed</li> <li>Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence</li> <li>Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our <a href="https://www.sumup.com/en-us/how-we-work/the-sumup-tech-radar/">Tech Radar.</a></li> <li>Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.</li> <li>Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.</li> <li>Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)</li> <li>Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.</li> <li>An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence</li> <li>A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice to have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.</p> <h3><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h3> <ul> <li>🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. title: Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.title: General Legal Counsel
raw.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role: First in-house counsel, with full ownership

As General Counsel & Head of Legal Ops, you own the legal function at Andercore: contracts, claims, employment, compliance and tax structuring. You report to the CEO and work with every leadership team member.

We don't want a large legal department. We want a legal setup that moves at the speed of the business. Today, legal runs through external counsel and individual effort. We need an owner who builds the frameworks, templates and playbooks to scale across Germany and Europe.

This is not a back-office role. You sit at the centre of cross-border supply chains, supplier negotiations, customer claims and operational risk. You hold the Syndikusrechtsanwalt designation. You make the function AI-native: language models do the first pass, external counsel handle complex judgment calls, you decide.

What you will do: Build the legal function

01 Commercial contracting

  • Draft, negotiate and close high-value contracts across sales, procurement, logistics and partnerships.

  • Advise Sales, Procurement and Finance on pricing and payment terms.

02 Templates and playbooks

  • Build contract templates, fallback rules and negotiation guidelines that shorten deal cycles.

  • Turn legal risk into clear decisions.

03 Claims and disputes

  • Resolve supplier disputes and customer claims pragmatically and commercially.

  • Quantify the risk in euros.

04 Employment law

  • Support People on hiring, contracts, terminations and restructurings under German law.

  • Draft HR guidelines and internal policies.

05 Compliance, governance, tax

  • Track EU and German regulation on trade, logistics, payments and data.

  • Run governance for our German entities and structure cross-border tax questions.

06 AI-native legal operations

  • Review large volumes of contracts in hours, not weeks.

  • Build self-serve tools for routine legal, HR and NDA requests.

What success looks like: Legal that speeds the business up

  • Standard contracts closed on our own templates, with a shorter contract cycle time

  • Most routine legal, HR and NDA requests answered through self-serve tools

  • Lower external counsel spend, with advisors used only for complex matters

  • Open claims and disputes tracked with a clear value and owner, and closed faster

  • Clear playbooks that Sales, Procurement and Finance use without asking legal first

  • Compliance and governance for all German entities current and documented

What you bring: You've worked in the business, now run legal for ours

  1. Volljurist/in with two Staatsexamina, eligible for registration as Syndikusrechtsanwalt.

  2. At least 3 years of post-qualification experience at a top-tier law firm or in-house team, ideally in tech, logistics or fast-scaling B2B businesses.

  3. Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts across sales, procurement and logistics.

  4. Working knowledge of German employment law and corporate governance.

  5. An AI-native way of working: you build your own workflows and a no-code legal stack, and you can show examples.

  6. An operational mindset: you value deal speed over long memos and quantify risk in numbers, not in "could" and "might".

  7. Energy, drive and curiosity, and comfort in a high-tempo, on-site environment with fast decisions.

  8. Fluent German and English. English is our internal working language.

We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d)
description: Shopware ist eine international führende Open-Commerce-Plattform für ambitionierte Unternehmen im digitalen Handel. Mit einem API-first-Ansatz, maximaler Flexibilität und einer starken Community schaffen wir zukunftsorientierte E-Commerce-Lösungen. Unsere 450 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa teilen eine Leidenschaft für Innovation, Offenheit und Teamgeist. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d), der für die Leitung mehrerer Engineering-Teams innerhalb unseres Services-Bereichs verantwortlich ist. In dieser Rolle stellst du sicher, dass jedes Team befähigt wird, unabhängige SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden zu erstellen, zu betreiben und zu pflegen, und förderst dabei operative Exzellenz und hohe Servicequalität. Du schaffst außerdem ein kollaboratives Umfeld, in dem Teams Tools, Infrastrukturpraktiken und Wissen sowohl intern als auch mit der breiteren Open-Source-Community teilen können. Diese Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder auch vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in ausgewählten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, ausgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags. Leadership & Management: Du führst, mentorst und unterstützt mehrere Engineering-Teams, die für die Bereitstellung unserer SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden verantwortlich sind. Operational Excellence: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Services höchsten Anforderungen an Performance, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit entsprechen. Dafür etablierst du entsprechende Standards und Prozesse, sorgst für kontinuierliches Monitoring und treibst proaktive Verbesserungen voran. AI & Engineering Transformation: Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Engineering-Organisation durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycles (SDLC), um Produktivität, Qualität und Kosteneffizienz nachhaltig zu steigern. Shared Infrastructure: Du treibst die Entwicklung einer gemeinsamen Infrastruktur sowie einheitlicher Anwendungsstandards über verschiedene Teams hinweg voran. Damit stellst du sicher, dass unsere Services konsistent entwickelt, bereitgestellt und betrieben werden. Agile & DevOps Practices: Du förderst eine agile und DevOps-orientierte Kultur innerhalb der Teams und stellst sicher, dass kontinuierliche Integration, Bereitstellung und Verbesserung fest in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb unserer Services verankert sind. Interne & externe Zusammenarbeit: Du förderst den teamübergreifenden Austausch von Tools, Frameworks und Best Practices – sowohl innerhalb von Shopware als auch mit unserer Community. So ermöglichst du es auch unserem Ökosystem, auf gemeinsame Technologien und Standards zurückzugreifen. Stakeholder Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Abteilungen wie Product und Operations zusammen, um Engineering-Initiativen mit unseren Unternehmenszielen abzustimmen und sicherzustellen, dass die Anforderungen unserer Kunden berücksichtigt werden. Das bringst du mit: Fundierte Führungserfahrung: Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Führung von Engineering-Teams, idealerweise mit einem Schwerpunkt auf der Bereitstellung von SaaS-Services in Cloud-Umgebungen. AWS-Expertise: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse der AWS-Cloud-Infrastruktur mit und hast praktische Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von Services mit Terraform und Kubernetes. Technisches Know-how: Du verfügst über tiefgehende Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Cloud-Architektur, Infrastrukturautomatisierung und Containertechnologien. Erfahrung mit KI-Transformation: Du hast bereits erfolgreich gezeigt, wie du Teams über den Einsatz von KI-gestützter Programmierung hinaus zu einem KI-basierten Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) führst. Dazu gehören die Automatisierung von Entwicklung, Testing und Qualitätssicherung, die Etablierung geeigneter Governance-Strukturen sowie nachweisbare Verbesserungen hinsichtlich Produktivität, Qualität und Kosten. Strategische Denkweise: Du bist in der Lage, strategische Initiativen für gemeinsame Tools, Infrastruktur und Best Practices zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, die sowohl unseren internen Teams als auch dem gesamten Ökosystem zugutekommen. Kommunikations- und Führungskompetenz: Du überzeugst durch ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten und hast bereits erfolgreich die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Teams sowie mit externen Stakeholdern gefördert. Community Engagement: Du begeisterst dich für Open Source und möchtest die Community aktiv unterstützen, indem du Best Practices, Tools und Infrastrukturkonzepte mit unserem Ökosystem teilst. Das bieten wir dir: Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert. Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge. Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware. Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy". Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft. Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung. Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents. ... und vieles mehr! title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Drone Port (m/f/d)
description: At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port enables our UAV platforms to launch, land, charge and return to mission readiness autonomously. As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will be the technical point of contact for core hardware topics across the Drone Port product. You will guide mechanical development from concept and prototypes through verification and validation, supporting the product lifecycle through series readiness and customer demonstrations. You will work very closely with Electrical Engineering, Embedded Software, Systems Engineering, Testing, Manufacturing, Procurement and external development partners and suppliers. Your work will help deliver reliable, available and manufacturable mechanical hardware for current and future Drone Port generations. What is your Day to Day Mission: Act as the technical point of contact for key hardware topics across the Drone Port product like housing, frame and opening mechanism Develop and assess mechanical concepts for future Drone Port generations, and support architecture and design decisions. Guide the mechanic development lifecycle from concept through prototypes, technical verification and system validation. Contribute to PCB, wiring harness and system designs with internal teams and external development partners. Plan, build and commission prototypes, and support integration, testing and customer demonstrations. Provide technical leadership to the hardware and electronics development team, and technical support to the Drone Port Testing team. Take ownership of agreed decisions and represent the Team Lead within the scope of delegated responsibilities. Support Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering and Manufacturing with mechanical expertise. Own hardware bills of materials, component availability and technical documentation, keeping records accurate and current. Coordinate technical orders and manage hardware inventory and development materials incl. in-house workshop management. Work with Procurement, Manufacturing and suppliers to ensure hardware is available when development milestones require it. Prepare hardware procurement decisions in line with defined budgets and development needs. Deliver hardware solutions on time and meet product quality and reliability goals. Continuously improve the hardware architecture for robustness, maintainability and manufacturability, and support the technical development of future Drone Port generations. What you bring to the team: A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable discipline. Several years of professional experience developing technical systems and designing hardware. Strong CAD skills; familiarity with CATIA V5 is an advantage. Experience building and testing mechanical and electronic and l prototypes. Experience leading a small, cross-functional sub-team or workstream, providing technical direction and taking ownership of outcomes. Experience industrialising prototypes and transitioning them into series production. Experience working with bills of materials, component management and suppliers. A structured, self-directed and solution-oriented approach to work. Excellent written and spoken English. Knowledge of German is an advantage. Du lebst mit uns gemeinsam die agile Softwareentwicklung in Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews beim Kunden und Retrospektiven mit Unterstützung unserer Agile Coaches . Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse in Versionsverwaltung, Designpatterns, Tests und SOLID-Prinzipien. Du hast Interesse an neuen Technologien. Nice to Have: Du kennst Prinzipien der sicheren Softwareentwicklung und hast Erfahrung mit Code Reviewing und Negative Testing. Deine Arbeitszeiten kannst du Dir nach Abstimmung mit dem Team und Deinen individuellen Bedürfnissen und Vorlieben selbst gestalten. Early Bird oder Nachteule? Beides kein Problem! WIE LÄUFT DIE BEWERBUNG AB? Sende uns Deine Bewerbung hier oder per Mail. Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen sollten einen aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf, relevante Zeugnisse und, falls vorhanden, Arbeitszeugnisse beinhalten. Nach Sichtung Deiner Unterlagen melden wir uns schnellstmöglich wieder bei Dir. Für diesen Prozess brauchen wir in der Regel nicht länger als eine Woche. Sind uns Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen positiv aufgefallen, vereinbaren wir einen Termin zum Telefoninterview mit Dir. Hast Du uns im Telefoninterview überzeugt, möchten wir Dich im persönlichen Interview in unserem schönen Büro gern besser kennenlernen. Haben wir beide nach dem Bewerbungsgespräch ein gutes Gefühl, kannst du uns und Dein potenziell zukünftiges Team bei einem Schnuppertag nochmal besser kennenlernen. title: Growth / Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Taxmaro ist eine KI-gestützte HR- und Payroll-Plattform, die Personal- und Lohnprozesse für Unternehmen und Steuerberater automatisiert. Statt manueller Routinearbeit übernimmt Taxmaro die Arbeit: Wir automatisieren Zeiterfassung, Abwesenheitsmanagement, Spesen, Vertragsverwaltung und die komplette Lohnvorbereitung – KI erkennt Daten aus Dokumenten, prüft Plausibilität und bereitet Abrechnungen vor, integriert mit DATEV und anderen Systemen. Unser Ziel: HR und Payroll so einfach, effizient und intelligent wie möglich zu gestalten – damit Teams sich auf Menschen statt auf Papierkram konzentrieren. Als Growth / Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du unsere Marketingkanäle end-to-end: Du baust Reichweite auf, generierst qualifizierte Leads und skalierst, was funktioniert. Du hast Budget, Tools und direkten Draht zur Gründung – und damit echten Einfluss auf unsere Wachstumskurve. Aufgaben Du steigerst die Bekanntheit von Taxmaro in unserer Zielgruppe – KMU, Personalverantwortliche und Steuerkanzleien. Du planst, launchst und optimierst Performance-Kampagnen über Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads und weitere Paid-Kanäle. Du baust SEO und Content-Marketing als nachhaltige Wachstumskanäle auf und aus. Du entwickelst Lifecycle- und E-Mail-Marketing, um Leads zu aktivieren und zu Kund:innen zu machen. Du steuerst die Marketingkanäle datenbasiert: Budgetallokation, CAC, Conversion-Rates und ROI im Blick. Du führst kontinuierlich Experimente und A/B-Tests durch, ziehst Learnings und skalierst die besten Hebel. Du baust Reporting und Dashboards auf und machst Wachstum mess- und steuerbar. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales und Produkt zusammen, damit aus Reichweite echte Pipeline wird. Qualifikation 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance-Marketing – idealerweise in B2B-SaaS. Du denkst und arbeitest entlang des gesamten Funnels und steuerst Marketing konsequent über KPIs wie CAC, Conversion-Rate, CPL und ROI. Starke analytische Fähigkeiten: Du baust Tracking, Attribution und Reporting auf und triffst Entscheidungen auf Datenbasis. Erfahrung in Conversion-Optimierung (CRO), A/B-Testing und kanalübergreifender Funnel-Optimierung. Versierter Umgang mit Analytics- und Marketing-Tools wie GA4, einem CRM (z. B. HubSpot) sowie Reporting-/BI-Tools; Paid- und SEO-Kanäle verstehst du, ohne reiner Kampagnen-Operator zu sein. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du konzipierst nicht nur, du setzt selbst um und misst Ergebnisse. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1/C2) und gutes Englisch. Ein Plus: Verständnis für HR-, Payroll- oder Steuerberatungs-Themen bzw. den deutschen Mittelstand. Benefits Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit: Du baust unser Wachstumsmarketing in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Grund auf mit. Eigenes Budget und die Tools, die du zum Skalieren brauchst. Direkter Draht zur Gründung, kurze Entscheidungswege und sichtbarer Impact. Attraktives Gehaltspaket mit Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg. Modernes Büro im Herzen Berlins, hochwertiges Equipment und regelmäßige Teamevents. Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen und persönliche Entwicklung. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung – ein Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze, warum Growth-Marketing bei Taxmaro für dich spannend ist, genügen! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Visiting Associate - 6-12 months
description: About First Momentum Ventures We're engineers at heart and investors by choice. That's why, what started in 2019 as a campus spin-off, we've grown into one of Europe's leading pre-seed funds , backing 50+ deeply technical startups reshaping industries from new industrials to novel computing. With our €35M+ second fund in full swing and Fund III on the horizon , we're hiring a Visiting Associate to join our investment team and contribute to deal flow, technical evaluation, and portfolio projects. Our aim is to be the #1 destination for deeply technical founders in Europe . We believe great teams create the future, and we're here to back them early and support them deeply . We aren't just capital providers; we invest in incredible individuals and view EQ as our greatest competitive advantage over traditional funds. The same applies to our own team: we win as a team (not individuals), believe in high agency & independence, and have every team member participate directly in the fund's economic upside. The Role As a Visiting Associate , you'll be a full member of our investment team with real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how the venture capital world truly operates. This role is designed for people with 1–3 years of professional experience who want to break into the venture ecosystem and accelerate their career. It's the perfect launchpad for ambitious talent aiming to become a Chief of Staff at a leading European startup , land a full-time VC role , or start their own company down the road. Whether you're coming from consulting, a fast-growing startup , or hold a master's degree with several internships in the startup ecosystem, we're looking for Europe's most driven young professionals to join us in building the leading pre-seed tech-focused venture fund in Europe . Tasks Find the most promising tech founders in Europe: Take the lead in sourcing high-potential pre-seed startups, running first calls independently, and developing your own conviction about which founders and ideas are truly exciting. Gain full exposure to the investment process: Work side-by-side with our investment team through the entire deal flow, from first contact and due diligence to investment committee and closing. You'll play a key role in evaluating opportunities and shaping investment decisions. Lead deep-dive research: Explore emerging technologies and market trends every week. Conduct sharp, data-driven analysis and present insights that influence our investment theses and strategic direction. Drive impact in portfolio projects: Support our portfolio founders hands-on, from building their go-to-market motion to automating workflows with AI and optimizing operations. Requirements You have 1-3 years of work experience in the startup ecosystem, consulting, or a technical role. You bring strong analytical capabilities and can move from technical papers to business models to founder conversations with ease. You work with extreme ownership and high agency, spotting opportunities, designing a plan, and executing without waiting for permission. You're genuinely curious about deeply technical domains. Whether you have an engineering background or just love learning how breakthrough technologies work, you're energized by technical depth. You communicate clearly and convincingly in both German and English, whether you're pitching a deal to partners or giving feedback to founders. Benefits Real ownership, not busy work : You'll make independent calls on deals, lead founder conversations, support DD processes end-to-end, and help drive critical projects for our portfolio companies. Technical depth you won't find elsewhere : Most of our team are engineers and scientists, which lets you develop a genuine understanding of breakthrough technologies, not just assessment skills. Exceptional colleagues who challenge you : Work alongside a team that values rigorous debate, mutual support, and winning together. You'll become part of the First Momentum family, even beyond your time with us. Full venture stack visibility : See everything from AI-powered sourcing to automated portfolio support. Gain the whole picture of how a leading European Deep Tech fund operates. Full flexibility with a remote-first culture balanced by regular in-person gatherings across Europe. Competitive pay: The compensation package will be adjusted to your professional experience and will be well above an internship salary. The perfect launchpad for your next move : Whether you're heading toward a full-time VC role, a Chief of Staff position in our portfolio, or eventually starting your own venture, this position sets you up for what's next. description: Du willst mehr als bloß Texte schreiben? Du willst mit deiner medizinischen Expertise echten Impact schaffen und die Zukunft der medizinischen Kommunikation aktiv mitgestalten? Dabei sollst du aktiv deine Ideen und Kreativität einbringen, um neue Impulse zu setzen, mit dem Ziel: wissenschaftliche Präzision, ein feines Gespür für die Zielgruppe und innovative Lösungen zu vereinen und so die Kommunikation im Healthcare-Bereich voranzutreiben. Gamechanger statt Standard-Medical-Writing – Du bringst frische Ideen ein und denkst über klassische Formate hinaus. Ob interaktive Formate, Storytelling oder innovative digitale Wissensvermittlung – du hilfst dabei, medizinische Kommunikation auf das nächste Level zu heben. Qualifikation Tiefgehendes medizinisches und wissenschaftliches Know-how – Du kennst dich in der medizinischen und pharmazeutischen Welt aus, verstehst komplexe Zusammenhänge und kannst sie präzise und zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten. Analytisches Denken & strategisches Verständnis – Du verstehst es, aus komplexen wissenschaftlichen Daten klare, überzeugende Inhalte zu entwickeln, die nicht nur informieren, sondern echten Mehrwert bieten. Zwei Schritte voraus – Du entwickelst nicht nur Inhalte für den aktuellen Bedarf, sondern hast immer die Trends und Herausforderungen der medizinischen Kommunikation von morgen im Blick. Ambitionierte High-Performance-Mentalität – Du willst nicht nur schreiben, sondern mit deinen Texten etwas bewegen. Du denkst unternehmerisch, setzt Projekte mit Eigenverantwortung und hoher Präzision um und hast den Anspruch, Erwartungen zu übertreffen. Effektive Zusammenarbeit & Team Spirit – Du bringst dich aktiv ins Team ein, teilst Wissen und hast Lust, gemeinsam mit anderen Expert:innen die Zukunft der medizinischen Kommunikation zu prägen. Benefits Deine Ideen zählen – Wir suchen kreative Köpfe mit eigenem Drive! Deshalb wollen wir bewusst, dass du nicht nur die Ideen anderer umsetzt, sondern selbst Impulse setzt. Dich erwarten Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein inspirierendes Office direkt am Hafen, Friday Afterwork Drinks und vieles mehr. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

title: Senior Staff SRE, Architecture Engineering: Hosted Runners
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>An overview of this role</strong></div> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">When a customer pushes a change, they need their CI/CD jobs to start quickly and run reliably, even when demand spikes. You'll help make that happen on GitLab.com by improving how Hosted Runners provision compute, isolate customer workloads, and recover from failures. Your decisions will shape how long customers wait for jobs to start and how efficiently GitLab uses cloud compute.</p> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">As a Senior Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you'll set technical direction across teams while continuing to write and operate production software in Go. You'll lead work across the runner control plane, worker provisioning, and job execution. Your primary focus will be GitLab.com, and you'll also provide technical leadership support for GitLab Dedicated Hosted Runners. You'll report to the engineering manager responsible for Hosted Runners.</p> <div class="text-[15px] mb-1 font-semibold"><strong>Some examples of our projects:</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Tuning autoscaling to reduce job wait times during demand spikes</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Evaluating ways to isolate customer workloads</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improving how runner usage is measured for capacity planning and billing</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Do</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Lead architecture and delivery across teams. Plan migrations with representative workload tests, safe capacity handovers, and rollback paths.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Write, review, and ship Go code across GitLab Runner, autoscaling components, cloud integrations, and operational tooling.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Improve reliability from job pickup through cleanup. Join the Runners Platform on-call rotation, investigate failures across system layers, and verify fixes in production.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Work with Security and Runner engineers to evaluate workload isolation, balancing security and compatibility with performance and cost.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Build observability that connects the customer experience with fleet behavior and guides capacity decisions. Partner with Finance, Product, and the billing platform team on usage metering and cost attribution.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Reduce recurring operational work through automation, tooling, and runbooks that engineers can use independently.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Mentor experienced engineers through design, implementation, and operations. Clarify ownership across teams and help engineers validate AI-assisted changes before they reach production.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></div> <ul class="space-y-1.5 ml-4"> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Recent hands-on experience building and operating production systems software such as controllers, agents, or schedulers. You've personally shipped code that handles challenges such as concurrency, retries, or resource cleanup.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Strong programming skills in Go or another systems language, with the ability to become productive in Go.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Deep Linux and networking knowledge. You can trace production failures across system layers and use measurements to validate fixes.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience operating Kubernetes in production, including diagnosing scheduling and resource issues and managing rollouts and recovery.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">Experience building or operating autoscaled or dynamically scheduled compute, such as VM fleets, serverless platforms, or batch systems. You bring experience with public cloud and infrastructure automation or comparable fleet operations.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A working understanding of the CI job lifecycle and the implications of running customer-controlled code. You can bring that knowledge from outside a CI/CD team.</li> <li class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed">A record of leading technical initiatives across teams and personally contributing to implementation through production. You build agreement through clear writing and asynchronous collaboration, and mentor engineers to own what they build and operate.</li> </ul> <div class="font-display font-bold text-[19px] mt-5 mb-1.5"><strong>About the team</strong></div> <p class="text-[15px] leading-relaxed mb-2">Hosted Runners operates the compute behind customers' CI/CD jobs. You'll work with Runner Core to turn lessons from operating the fleet into improvements to the open-source GitLab Runner. You'll also work with Product and partner teams to agree on priorities and ownership for shared changes.</p> <div class="text-[15px] mb-1 font-semibold"><strong>Learn more:</strong></div> <ul class="ml-4 space-y-1"> <li><a class="text-[15px] font-medium" href="https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/dedicated/hosted_runners/" target="_blank">Hosted runners for GitLab Dedicated (docs)</a></li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&nbsp;and geographic location.&nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company: domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match. AI handles the heavy lifting, our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why Join Our People Team

● There's genuine room to bring your own ideas to the wider People Partner team: templates, calibration frameworks, how a restructure gets structured, and shape those alongside your peers rather than working them out alone in your own corner.

● We're growing, and a lot of the people strategy isn't fixed yet. You'll have a real say in shaping it, not just delivering against decisions someone else already made.

● You'll support Technology and Product, in a way that fits how we do things at Redgate.

About the Role

This isn't a role about running HR process. You'll operate as a genuine strategic partner to the Technology and Product leadership teams, helping shape, own, and deliver the people strategy that drives their goals and, in turn, Redgate's wider goals.

  • You'll sit inside the leadership team's regular rhythm, seeing the roadmap and trade-offs early enough to shape them, not just react once there's a people problem

  • Full ownership of the people strategy for Technology and Product: headcount plan, org design, succession, and retention, agreed directly with the functional exec

  • Real thought leadership beyond your own patch: spot patterns across functions (promotion criteria that don't hold up, gaps in how senior hires are onboarded) and bring them to the wider People Partner team

  • Coach and challenge leaders directly, including pushing back on a VP or exec when the data or your judgement says they've got it wrong

  • Find practical ways to bring AI into how the function and the People Partner team work, not as a bolt-on

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Solid experience as a strategic People Partner or HR Business Partner in a high-growth or fast-changing business, ideally tech or SaaS, partnering directly with product or engineering leadership

  • A commercial mindset: able to connect the business issue behind a people problem and the people issue behind a business problem, with a track record of turning that into commercial outcomes

  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and make decisions stick without relying on formal authority

  • Confident using people metrics (attrition, engagement, hiring velocity, time to fill) to diagnose what's really going on, not just report on it

  • Evidence of shaping how a People team works, not just delivering inside your own area, for example building a framework or fixing a broken process

What We Offer

● Salary range: £60,000 - £70,000

● Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office

● Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off

● Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression

● Private health insurance

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

description: About HIVED 📦 At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing. Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery. A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better. Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market. Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures , Maersk Growth , Pale Blue Dot VC , Eka Ventures , NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery. Role Overview 📝 We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML / Operations Research Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network. You'll join the Routing Squad , which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. You'll design the optimisation, forecasting and ML models at the core of it, and bring them into production together with backend engineers, data scientists, analysts and our operations teams. This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how we model the network and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time. The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities? What You'll Be Doing 🚀 Build the models. Design and implement optimisation models and algorithms for routing, supply-demand matching, capacity planning and other core logistics challenges. Turn ambiguity into models. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production. Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models with our backend engineers, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes. Explore new approaches. Lead the exploration and evaluation of new approaches, from linear programming and heuristics to machine learning-based optimisation. Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data. Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for how we test and evaluate our models. What We're Looking For 🔎 Typically 5+ years of experience building optimisation or ML models and shipping them into production systems. A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the modelling approach or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams. The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact. Solid coding skills: Python preferred, though experience in other languages like C++, Java or Go is also valued. An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains. Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations. You also bring depth in at least one of: Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems. Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production. Technologies We Use 💻 Python, Go AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript) GCP, BigQuery, Looker Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus GitHub, GitHub Actions Claude Code Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design Our interviewing process 🪜 Intro call with the hiring manager Live coding challenge solving a problem A take home case study, followed by a discussion On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture) Our Values 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate. 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not. 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely.
