Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 


Role Overview 📝

We're looking for a Senior or Staff ML / Operations Research Engineer to take on some of the hardest problems at HIVED: the planning systems that decide how every parcel moves through our 100% electric delivery network.

You'll join the Routing Squad, which owns HIVED's entire planning pipeline: demand forecasting, capacity planning and scheduling, sortation, our collections network and large-scale route optimisation. You'll design the optimisation, forecasting and ML models at the core of it, and bring them into production together with backend engineers, data scientists, analysts and our operations teams.

This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how we model the network and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time.

The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities?

What You'll Be Doing 🚀

  • Build the models. Design and implement optimisation models and algorithms for routing, supply-demand matching, capacity planning and other core logistics challenges.

  • Turn ambiguity into models. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production.

  • Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models with our backend engineers, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes.

  • Explore new approaches. Lead the exploration and evaluation of new approaches, from linear programming and heuristics to machine learning-based optimisation.

  • Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data.

  • Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for how we test and evaluate our models.

What We're Looking For 🔎

  • Typically 5+ years of experience building optimisation or ML models and shipping them into production systems.

  • A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the modelling approach or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams.

  • The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact.

  • Solid coding skills: Python preferred, though experience in other languages like C++, Java or Go is also valued.

  • An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations.

You also bring depth in at least one of:

  • Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems.

  • Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production.

Technologies We Use 💻

  • Python, Go

  • AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript)

  • GCP, BigQuery, Looker

  • Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus

  • GitHub, GitHub Actions

  • Claude Code

  • Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design


Our interviewing process 🪜

  • Intro call with the hiring manager

  • Live coding challenge solving a problem

  • A take home case study, followed by a discussion

  • On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture)


Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

Where in the world of Kaluza will I be working?

 

You’ll be joining the Identity & Access Management (IAM) team, which sits within the Cyber Security squad in the Kaluza technology community, working hand-in-hand with security engineering as well as with Kaluza’s architecture team and technical leaders across our software engineering community. Your initial focus will be on our product IAM space, covering authentication & authorisation services that ensure the appropriate accesses are permitted on the Kaluza retail platform, whether that’s human or machine. The role will broaden over time to encompass our enterprise IAM and PAM solutions which protect us as a business, enabling us to better align these two aspects of IAM in use across Kaluza.

 

With millions of customers across multiple geographic regions, we naturally invest significant effort into availability, performance, security and observability, and the teams pride themselves on their ability to maintain a balance between rapid development of new services, iterative quality & feature enhancements alongside being highly responsive in incidents.

What will I be doing?

 

  • Collaborate with technical, product leadership to help shape and continuously improve our IAM technical strategy and solutions architecture

  • Lead the team hands-on in resolving complex technical issues, evaluating technical options, designing services and scoping engineering work

  • Work with client engineering teams to help them understand our IAM architecture and how to get the most out of our platform

  • Take the lead on evolving our identity and access best practices across engineering, proactively helping teams to apply these with expert advice and automation

  • Use your deep understanding of the IAM domain to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders across Kaluza as well as client teams

  • Mentoring and coaching engineers within the IAM space, helping them balance risk with speed and quality

  • Continuously improve quality across reliability, observability, functional and non-functional testing as well as development processes and documentation

  • Horizon scanning for emerging technologies and approaches to IAM, enabling Kaluza to continue to evolve, keeping us ahead of adversaries as well as cost-effective

What you will bring

 

  • Good experience of both mentoring engineers as well as developer collaboration (e.g. pairing, swarming)

  • Developing, testing, deploying and maintaining quality SaaS APIs in AWS

  • Working with (and continuous improvement of use with) fundamental DevSecOps engineering elements such as CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure As Code, Kubernetes containerization and platform health alerting & monitoring

  • Application of basic modern identity & access management techniques and standards, such as OAuth2.0 or SAML2.0

  • Integrating an IdP into services to enable SSO and/or federated identity

  • Use of encrypted JWTs as part of an OIDC-compliant user authentication flow and/or creating policies in an RBAC and ABAC environment

  • Experience of applying AI to your own work as well as enabling others to safely build it into their development ways of working

  • Working knowledge of Okta or equivalent solutions, to enable workforce identity and enforce access management policies

  • Experience of applying architectural and software design patterns in a complex domain/environment

  • Experience of being a senior subject matter expert in operational incidents

We would still encourage you to apply even if you don’t have experience of all of the above - we look for potential as much as skills fit.

Leadership, quality & delivery

You’ll be…

  • Proficient at applying your technical and commercial knowledge to a risk based approach, taking the lead on assessing current and future technology and designs

  • A pragmatic decision-maker who takes into account the technical & commercial costs and consequences of those decisions

  • Skilled at identifying new or improved ways of working and driving efficiencies

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements within the platform to balance meeting information security and commercial goals

  • Accomplished at influencing both upwards and outwards, using a mixture of communications skills

  • Skilled in bringing alignment, clarity of thought and direction to information security, product and engineering challenges

  • Able to establish a clear vision for large-scale technical direction and champion alignment to that vision across multiple teams.

  • Experienced in fostering a culture of learning and improvement, challenging engineering leadership to better support this

 

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

description: About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. The Production Engineering Team Examples of key problems the team is working on Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal. Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up. Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it. Role Scope Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers. Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours. Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs. Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in. Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic. What We're Looking For The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it. You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone. You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet. You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero. Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling. Salary & Benefits Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity). Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms. Health, dental, and vision insurance. As an Engineering Manager – AI, you will lead a team building and operating the platforms customers use to train and serve AI models on our GPU infrastructure, joining one of our AI teams: MLOps Training or MLOps Inference. You'll combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership, and cross-functional collaboration, working closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security, and other engineering teams. Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of around nine engineers across software, platform, DevOps, and test.

  • Own delivery end to end: planning, prioritisation, quality, and operational readiness.

  • Partner with Product to turn priorities into clear technical plans and achievable milestones.

  • Provide technical leadership on architecture, reliability, scalability, and engineering trade-offs.

  • Set strong engineering practices for design, testing, observability, documentation, and incident learning.

  • Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing engineers. Hiring is a large part of the first year: expect around two hours a day on it.

  • Support career development through regular feedback, coaching, and progression planning.

  • Bring AI-assisted engineering into daily work, within our guardrails.

Your Profile

  • Experience leading engineering teams building cloud platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, or distributed systems.

  • Proven experience in people management, hiring, coaching, and performance development.

  • A strong technical background: you engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

  • A good understanding of:

  • Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, containers

  • Platform engineering: APIs, automation, IAM, observability, reliability

  • Distributed systems: scaling, consistency, failure handling

  • Engineering operations: incident response, capacity, performance, production ownership

  • Strong delivery and prioritisation skills across competing priorities.

  • Comfortable working closely with product and other engineering leaders in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

  • Technical judgement: Challenge designs and guide trade-offs without owning every implementation detail.

  • Ownership: Take responsibility for both team health and engineering outcomes.

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

  • Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes, containers

  • Platform engineering: APIs, automation, IAM, observability, reliability

  • Distributed systems: scaling, consistency, failure handling

  • Engineering operations: incident response, capacity, performance, production ownership

  • Strong delivery and prioritisation skills across competing priorities.

You’ll automate and continuously improve our deployment pipelines, cloud and bare-metal environments, and Kubernetes-based orchestration layer, so our systems scale reliably to support high-performance AI and GPU workloads.

You’ll partner with Infrastructure, SRE and Product Engineering teams to embed a strong DevOps culture across the organisation. You’ll champion infrastructure as code, observability and automation at every layer of the stack, and help improve how we build and operate systems at scale.

Our engineering teams cover Infrastructure, Cluster, Network, Storage, Cloud, Observability, Security, and AI (Training & Inference).

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and continuously optimise CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions to support fast, reliable, and repeatable software delivery

  • Own and evolve Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform and Ansible, ensuring infrastructure is version-controlled, peer-reviewed, and consistently provisioned across dev, staging, and production

  • Scale CI to handle agent-driven change volume, including merge queues and fast, parallel test runs

  • Identify and eliminate human and agent bottlenecks across the software development lifecycle

  • Instrument DORA metrics and agent adoption: agent versus hand-written merges, defect and rework rates

  • Manage and maintain hosted application environments, ensuring high availability, scalability, and smooth deployment of services into production

  • Partner closely with Engineers to deeply understand their development workflows and release processes, identifying and removing friction points that slow delivery

  • Measure and improve the developer experience, improving productivity

  • Champion a self-service DevOps culture, enabling development teams to own their deployments and operational concerns through well-designed tooling, documentation, and guardrails

  • Help make runbooks and decision records a natural part of our definition of done

Your Profile

  • Proven experience in DevOps engineering and best practices

  • Hands-on experience running and automating infrastructure across public cloud and bare-metal environments

  • Strong experience with CI/CD workflows, observability, security and automation best practices

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Helm and other containerisation related tooling

  • Demonstrable scripting ability in Go, Python and Shell

  • Strong knowledge of branching, deployment strategies including the use of Git based version control

  • Ownership: Take features from design through production, and stay accountable for how they run.

  • Pragmatism: Ship what matters, simply, and improve it from real-world feedback.

  • Collaboration: Work openly with product, infrastructure and SRE, and share what you learn.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

About the Role

As a Principal Storage Software Engineer at Radiant, you’ll be a hands-on technical leader, driving the design and development of our storage services across object, block, and file, built to deliver the performance, durability, and scale that AI training, inference, and data-intensive workloads demand.

You’ll set the standard for storage engineering excellence, working closely with other principal engineers to align on strategy and drive technical leadership. You’ll partner with Engineering and Product teams to build storage that integrates seamlessly across the stack, and mentor engineers across multiple squads. You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping storage direction, design decisions, and cross-team collaboration.

Our Engineering teams are grouped as follows:

  • Infrastructure: Compute, Infra, Network & Storage

  • Platform: Cloud, Observability & Security

  • AI: Training & Inference

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the technical vision and architecture for Radiant's storage services, and lead their design and implementation.

  • Design and build storage systems across object, block, and file, including the control plane, the data plane, and integration with existing Radiant services.

  • Translate product requirements into robust architectures, APIs, and technical designs, working closely with the Storage Product Manager.

  • Own the performance, durability, availability, and consistency characteristics of the storage platform, and define the service levels it can credibly meet.

  • Profile, benchmark, and tune storage throughput, latency, and IOPS for AI training, inference, and other data-intensive workloads.

  • Lead integration of storage with compute, Kubernetes (CSI), networking, IAM, observability, and developer tooling.

  • Design for failure through replication, snapshots, data protection, failure recovery, and safe upgrades at scale.

  • Drive operational excellence with SRE and Infra Ops, including capacity planning, observability, incident response, and post-incident improvements.

  • Raise the engineering bar across the organisation through mentoring, design and code review, and technical standards.

Your Profile

  • Extensive experience building and operating large-scale distributed storage systems or storage-heavy cloud infrastructure.

  • A track record of technical leadership at staff or principal level, including setting direction across multiple teams and delivering complex, high-stakes systems.

  • Strong hands-on engineering skills in one or more systems languages such as Go or similar.

  • Deep technical expertise across:

  • Storage: object, block, and file storage, snapshots, replication, erasure coding, caching, tiering, data lifecycle

  • Protocols & interfaces: S3, NFS, SMB, CSI, NVMe/NVMe-oF, RDMA, POSIX semantics, storage APIs

  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, containers, high-performance networking, GPU clusters, cloud platforms

  • Reliability: durability, availability, consistency models, consensus, failure recovery, data integrity

  • Observability & security: metrics, logging, tracing, IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, auditability

  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as WEKA, VAST, DDN, Lustre, Ceph, MinIO, Pure Storage, or similar.

  • Understanding of AI and HPC storage patterns, such as large-scale training data pipelines, checkpointing, and high-throughput parallel file systems.

  • Able to reason about trade-offs between performance, durability, availability, cost, and operational complexity.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear design documents and explaining complex trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

What You Bring

  • Storage domain expertise: Understand how storage architecture affects application and workload performance, down to the hardware.

  • Engineering excellence: Write and review code that sets the standard for correctness, performance, and maintainability.

  • Architectural judgement: Make sound long-term decisions on systems where data loss is not an option.

  • Technical leadership: Influence direction across teams without relying on authority, and grow the engineers around you.

  • Systems thinking: Understand how storage interacts with compute, networking, and the rest of the cloud platform.

  • Ownership: Drive storage capabilities from design through production, operation, and continuous improvement.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

Our process: Talent screen → Hiring Manager → Technical interview (two Principal Engineers) → Whiteboard Exercise → Final.

title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
description: About H: Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement , both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move. H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents , fully managed agents that take actions on computers. What you own Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA . What you'd be doing Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers. Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument. Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use. When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law. Who you'd work with Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams. What we think it takes Likely a good fit if you Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar. Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience. Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance. Have worked somewhere that was growing fast. Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too. raw.title: Legal Counsel - Commercial and AI
raw.description:
About H:

Our agents act on computers for our customers, clicking through software and filling in fields, so our contracts have to answer some awkward questions. Who owns what an agent produces? Who answers when an output turns out to be wrong? Can customer data train our models? Our terms already take a position on all three, and they're public: read our general terms of service and our data processing agreement, both in French, under French law, and last updated in June 2026. This job is drafting and negotiating contracts like these, and keeping them current as the product and the law move.

H builds computer-use agents for enterprises, from Paris. In July 2026 we launched Computer-use Agents, fully managed agents that take actions on computers.

What you own

Our business teams bring in the deals. You'd write the paper behind them and lead the negotiation. When AI regulation or data protection law changes, you'd help work out what our contracts need to say now. You'd report to Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, who is also the data protection officer named in our DPA.

What you'd be doing

  • Drafting and advising on a wide range of contracts, AI service agreements among them, with customers, partners and suppliers.

  • Working through the other side's mark-up. Our general terms cap our liability on paid services at the higher of €100 or the previous 12 months' fees, for example. When a customer's lawyers push on it, you'd work out where we hold. Then you'd make the argument.

  • Turning new products and new AI law into contract changes and negotiation guidance. What we ship includes open-weight models: Holo3-35B-A3B is on Hugging Face under Apache 2.0, fine-tuned from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.

  • Answering engineers and business teams on how to deploy AI within the rules. Customers can see on our Trust Center that we hold ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 1 and SOC 2 Type 2, and which subprocessors we use.

  • When needed, questions outside contracts: employment, corporate or competition law.

Who you'd work with

Julie Martinez, our General Counsel, is hiring for this role. You'd join our Legal team and work closely with engineers and business teams.

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Hold a master's in law and are admitted to the bar.

  • Have a minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant legal experience.

  • Know data protection law well (GDPR and the rules around it), along with IP, contract law and liability, and regulatory compliance.

  • Have worked somewhere that was growing fast.

  • Can explain a legal position plainly to an engineer. Work well on your own and adapt when plans change. An international outlook matters here too.

Stronger still if you built that experience negotiating contracts at a tech or AI company.

You do not need to have worked at an AI company before. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

How we hire

Three conversations. First a 30 minute call with our Talent team, then 30 minutes with Julie, and last a conversation with a member of our leadership team.

Practicalities

It's a hybrid job: you'd be in Paris with the team for three days in an average week. We offer a competitive package.

description: Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) Lieu : Location: Paris, France — (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau) Team: Product Management Contrat : CDI Reporting To: Group Product Manager Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités. Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais. À propos de Kaluza Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié. Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours. Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen. Ce que vous ferez Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec une équipe d’ingénieurs logiciels sur l’expansion belge de notre domaine Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL), l’un des domaines produit centraux de la plateforme Kaluza. Il gère les informations sur les clients, les comptes et les contrats, et porte les parcours client associés (par exemple un déménagement ou un changement de contrat). C’est un domaine full stack : une interface pour les conseillers du service client, des API qui exposent les données et des services backend qui portent les bases de données et la logique de workflow. Vous travaillez donc sur l’ensemble du domaine produit. Ce n’est pas un poste de product owner : vous portez des fonctionnalités de bout en bout, du dialogue avec les clients et les utilisateurs jusqu’à la livraison du logiciel, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe et la discovery. Des déplacements ponctuels en Belgique sont possibles (environ deux par trimestre). Traduire les exigences du marché belge en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché belge de l’énergie en exigences produit précises. Devenir le partenaire de confiance du client : travailler main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché belge pour comprendre leurs besoins, mener la discovery en ateliers afin de définir comment le produit fonctionne et de cadrer le périmètre, construire les exigences ensemble et bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vers vous en premier. Cette proximité vous aide à orienter ce que CAL construira ensuite. Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel, en interrogeant les données, en explorant les schémas d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez l’IA (par exemple Claude Code) chaque jour comme un multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer, pas seulement pour rédiger des documents. Aligner les équipes globales et locales sur toutes les fonctions : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, le QA et d’autres équipes, avec une influence full stack, en animant le quotidien de l’équipe (priorités, cérémonies, réunions), pour que chacun vise les bons résultats. Vous faites le lien entre les équipes globales et locales pour nourrir les priorités et la stratégie. Ce que vous apportez Idéalement, vous avez ou vous êtes : Une expérience avérée de Product Manager , de Business Analyst ou d’un rôle équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un parcours réussi de localisation de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux. Un français courant et un anglais professionel : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, et vous passez facilement de l’une à l’autre langue. De l’aisance en direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les profils seniors alignés et impliqués. Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard et concret, vous êtes à l’aise pour construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt que d’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données et les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous savez prototyper avec les outils d’IA modernes. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur, mais vous pensez comme tel et vous tenez votre place dans une conversation technique. Vous raisonnez aussi bien sur un modèle de données que sur ce que l’utilisateur final voit à l’écran. Une communication claire et incisive, et l’habitude du travail transverse : vous savez aller à l’essentiel et expliquer la complexité technique et marché à des publics variés, clients compris. Vous collaborez avec l’ingénierie, le QA, le BA, le programme, le delivery, etc., pour livrer des solutions localisées. La maîtrise des outils d’IA à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie produit, de la discovery et l’idéation jusqu’à la livraison et l’itération. Nos valeurs Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza : Jouer pour gagner : La fierté collective de décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle. Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets. Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole. Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego. Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue. Nos avantages Rémunération & protection : Bonus discrétionnaire, mutuelle Alan, prévoyance (assurance vie et décès) via Alan, et cotisations standard de Sécurité sociale (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage) Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport domicile-travail, indemnité de télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 € Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + 1 jour pour votre anniversaire + jours fériés + jours de RTT (11), congés « Moments That Matter », congé pour événement familial, deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, flexibilité dans l’organisation du travail et éligibilité à un congé sabbatique (Career Break) Venez comme vous êtes Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel. Si le poste vous enthousiasme mais que vous ne cochez pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis de vous lire. Pour en savoir plus, rendez-vous sur notre careers page et sur LinkedIn. With a presence in more than 70 countries, Decathlon is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.</p> <h2><strong>Job Description</strong></h2> <p>Decathlon is seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist to join our Demand and Assortment Planning team within the Supply Chain department. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in developing AI models into production and providing insights/recommendations to optimise demand forecasting and assortment planning processes. We welcome candidates with expertise in time series forecasting and a passion for leveraging data to drive business decisions.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Analyse and study assortment planning, including foundation models.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain Business, Engineering, and Product Development to align Data and AI <h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field.</li> Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Master's or Ph.D. degree in Data Science, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field.</li> <li>Minimum 5 years of experience in Data Science.</li> <li>Experience in demand forecasting, inventory optimisation, or supply chain analytics.</li> <li>Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.</li> <li>Previous experience in the retail or e-commerce industry is a plus.</li> <li>Experience in implementing Generative AI to enhance forecasting, alongside optimising business or organisational processes for product delivery.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Technical Environment</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Execution Engine: Databricks, AWS EKS, Sagemaker</li> <li>Payload: Python, Spark, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow / Pytorch, Pyspark&nbsp;</li> About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Application Security Engineer to help secure our product and platform through hands-on security architecture and engineering. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, taking ownership from identifying risks through designing, implementing, and rolling out solutions.

We’re a lean security team, so your work will span security reviews, vulnerability management, platform hardening, automation, incident response, and compliance engineering. Alongside finding and fixing vulnerabilities, you’ll identify opportunities to prevent entire classes of risks through shared security controls and centralized enforcement. You’ll help decide where these investments matter most and build solutions that teams can adopt as the company grows.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement shared security controls that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities and centralize enforcement across applications and services.

  • Partner with engineers on architecture and threat modeling, translating risks into concrete designs for authorization, service identity, tenant isolation, and data protection.

  • Build security controls and secure defaults into application frameworks, service templates, and infrastructure modules, making them straightforward for teams to adopt.

  • Develop automation that connects security tools with engineering workflows, adds context to findings, and automates remediation where appropriate.

  • Own vulnerability management across internal findings, automated tooling, external assessments, and researcher reports.

  • Review code, perform targeted security testing, and manage vulnerabilities through verified remediation. Use recurring findings to identify where a shared control or architectural change would prevent similar issues.

  • Support the compliance team by implementing technical controls, automating procedures, and validating that controls operate as intended.

  • Help investigate security incidents and use the findings to improve architecture, controls, and detection.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with substantial security ownership.

  • Strong understanding of web, API, and distributed-system security, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and sensitive data handling.

  • Experience taking security controls from architectural design through implementation and adoption across multiple services or teams.

  • Ability to design defense in depth, establish clear trust boundaries, and limit the impact of compromised components or credentials.

  • Strong coding skills: you can review production code, contribute fixes, and build maintainable tooling and shared security components.

  • Experience integrating security tools into engineering workflows and using context and automation to reduce manual work.

  • Sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the independence to take an ambiguous problem through to a working solution.

Why join us?

  • Work closely with engineers building AI systems used in critical enterprise operations.

  • Own substantial security projects and help shape a growing security program.

  • Have the autonomy to design solutions, implement them, and see their impact in production.

  • Join a company backed by leading investors.

  • Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

  • Be the named lawyer on the account. Senior partners, GCs, and heads of legal deal with you directly.

  • Customers in your portfolio renewed, expanded, and brought in referrals because of you.

  • Competitive salary and transparent ESOP. You are early enough that ownership means something.

raw.title: Electrical Technician, Magnet Systems
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM AND ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

We are looking for an Electrical Technician to support our R&D activities across our sites in Villigen and Böttstein, Aargau. You will be responsible for developing electrical infrastructure and executing electrical installation, maintenance and troubleshooting tasks for our R&D facilities & experiments. Your work will directly enable our teams to build, test, and iterate faster.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Experimental Support

You will help connect our experiments to their measurement and control systems.

  • Instrumentation Wiring: Assemble control panels, junction boxes and cabinets. Wire sensors, heaters, instrumentation, and related electrical interfaces.

  • System Integration: Support integration of power supplies, control panels, acquisition systems, and test equipment from an electrical perspective.

  • Commissioning Support: Assist with electrical checks, verification, and commissioning of experimental setups.

  • Troubleshooting: Diagnose and repair electrical faults, component failures, and other problems affecting experiments.

2. Electrical Infrastructure

You will support the definition and upgrade of electrical infrastructure for our R&D program

  • Electrical Connection: Power and connect our experimental setups, prototype rigs, and manufacturing equipment.

  • Installation Oversight: Oversee electrical interventions by external contractors

3. Safety and Quality

Reliable operation depends on fast diagnosis and safe maintenance of electrical systems.

  • Safety & Compliance: Ensure installations and modifications are safe and compliant with relevant norms, regulations and internal procedures.

  • Maintenance: Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical infrastructure, test hardware, and support systems.

  • Quality of Execution: Ensure that installations are neat, maintainable, and consistent with industrial norms. Maintain a safe, functional, and organized electrical environment

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Electrical Technician who is safety-conscious, deeply practical, and enjoys making technical systems work reliably.

  • Background: Training and practical experience as an Electrician, Electrical Technician, or similar.

  • Qualification: Automatiker, Elektroinstallateur (EFZ Swiss vocational diploma) or equivalent qualification

  • Safety Mindset: Good knowledge of safe electrical working practices and regulations.

  • Technical Capability: Comfortable with producing and reading electrical diagrams, sizing cables and protection devices, performing modifications, and troubleshooting real systems.

  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic R&D environment where setups evolve quickly and where engineers, scientists, and technicians collaborate closely.

Nice to have

  • Driving license valid in Switzerland

  • Experience in R&D environments

  • Experience drawing and updating Single-Line Diagrams (SLDs) and developing power distribution networks

  • Familiarity with ECAD software

raw.title: Security Engineer
raw.description:
About Unblu

Unblu helps the world's leading banks and insurance companies deliver conversational finance solutions. We provide highly secure engagement and collaboration software, enabling financial institutions to enrich the digital experience of their clients.

By choosing a career with Unblu you choose to join an international, and innovation-savvy company. With our head office situated in Basel, Switzerland and additional offices in Bulgaria, Germany, the UK, Canada and the USA, you’ll be joining an international team dedicated to shaping the future of digital engagement. While Unblu is run as an independent company with global scope, we are fortunate to have Swiss Post as our anchor shareholder, providing long term support and vision to the company. 

The Role

We're looking for a Security Engineer to work alongside our SRE and engineering teams, embedding security across the full software development lifecycle. You'll own a mix of defensive operations and developer-facing security tooling, from WAF rule management and CVE triage to building the pipelines that keep our deployments safe by default.

This role sits at the intersection of application security, platform security and operations. You'll partner closely with engineering to ship secure software, and with SRE when things need to be hardened or investigated. We run entirely in the cloud, with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

You'll report to our VP SRE. An on-call rotation shared with SRE may be part of this role; we'll finalize expectations with the successful candidate.

Responsibilities

  • Embed security practices throughout the software development lifecycle, from design review to production monitoring, working hands-on with engineering teams
  • Build, maintain and evolve the security tooling in our GitLab CI/CD pipelines: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection and container scanning
  • Review Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for our applications, track supply chain risk and drive remediation of issues in third-party components
  • Own CVE triage end to end: assess relevance, prioritize based on exposure and exploitability, and coordinate remediation with product teams
  • Manage and tune our Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, balancing strong protection against false-positive noise
  • Run internal security audits, document findings clearly and work with teams to close gaps
  • Coordinate our annual external penetration test end to end; review pen test reports commissioned by our customers, translate findings into actionable work and respond back to the customer
  • Lead the technical investigation, containment and recovery of security incidents together with SRE
  • Provide technical evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, DORA resilience testing and customer security questionnaires, together with our Compliance Manager
  • Help run or grow our external bug bounty program (optional scope): triage reports, coordinate with researchers and drive fixes through engineering

Requirements

  • Practical, hands-on security experience in a SOC, incident response or security engineering context, where you've done the work, not just written policy
  • A degree, recognized certification (OSCP, CISSP, GIAC or equivalent) or structured training in information security
  • Comfortable working across the entire software lifecycle, shifting between developer collaboration, operations and governance
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitLab CI
  • Familiarity with vulnerability scanners, SBOM tools (Syft, Grype, Trivy, Dependency-Track or similar) and WAF platforms (Cloud Armor, Cloudflare or similar)
  • Working knowledge of GCP security primitives (IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Binary Authorization, Security Command Center); comparable experience in another major cloud is fine if you're ready to go deep on GCP
  • A clear communicator who can explain risk to engineers in terms they'll act on, and present confidently to customer security teams and auditors
  • Fluent in English; German or French is a plus

Benefits

  • An interesting and rewarding role in the Sales team in the world's leading live collaboration software manufacturer
  • Direct reporting line to the VP SRE
  • Work in a diverse environment: 30+ nationalities across 8 locations
  • Competitive salary, 5-week holiday, and great referral bonuses 
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working environment
  • Our office in Basel is next to the main railway station

strong&nbsp;understanding of transformer inference&nbsp;bottlenecks involving&nbsp;KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability Our system runs on-prem at industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, and military sites, integrated with the cameras, networks, and robots already in place. You survey the site, plan the deployment, install and integrate the system, tune it to the site's conditions, and hand it over to operators who will rely on it daily. You are also the technical face of Laelaps on site. You work with security operators to understand how they actually work and where the bottlenecks are, align with their leadership on what success looks like, and translate what you learn into configuration, code, and product priorities. Early deployments you run alongside the founders; over time you own sites and accounts independently. Expect roughly half your time at customer sites in Switzerland and Europe, and the rest in Zurich, turning field lessons into tooling and automation that make each deployment faster than the last. This is an engineering role with a customer in the room, not a support or services role. Integrations: connect existing cameras, sensors, VMS platforms, and robots into one coordinated system, and write the glue code where no integration exists yet. System tuning: calibrate detection and tracking to each site's terrain, lighting, and threat profile until the system performs in the field as it does in the demo. Pilots to production: make POCs succeed technically, because pilots that work become contracts. Customer trust: train operators, respond fast when something breaks, and be the engineer customers ask for by name. The deployment playbook: turn every hard-won lesson into runbooks, tooling, and automation that compound. Product feedback: bring real field signal back to the core engineering team and shape the roadmap with it. You listen more than you pitch, you read the room, and you switch registers between the guard house and the boardroom without breaking stride. You debug across the whole stack without ceremony: is it the hardware, the network, the driver, the model, or the config? Above all, you take personal ownership of the outcome: the deployment works because you made it work, and the customer trusts us because you earned it. Your Background 3+ years of relevant software, robotics, embedded systems, or systems integration experience. Checking cable connections at 2 a.m. at a client site is second nature while debugging an issue on a customer side. Experience with cameras, VMS platforms (Milestone, Genetec, or similar), ONVIF/RTSP, or the physical security industry. Computer vision or ML deployment experience, especially optimising inference on edge GPUs. Robotics experience: ROS2 and Rviz2, robot integration, or fleet operations. Experience in defence, government, or other regulated environments. French, Italian, or another European language. title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt. raw.title: Senior Manager CMI Europe
raw.description:
The Practical Detail 
Location: Amsterdam 
Hybrid model 

Why this role matters
We are looking for a commercially minded Head of Consumer & Market Insights Europe to ensure that consumers are at the heart of the decisions shaping the future growth of our great brands. This role is vital because it brings the consumer's voice into every strategic choice, from brand positioning to innovation and execution. In this role you will translate complex market and consumer data into clear, actionable opportunities that drive better food experiences in kitchens across Europe. Your work will help the business anticipate shifts in taste, nutrition, and consumer needs, ensuring Flora Food Group stays one step ahead. 

What you'll do 

  • Lead the European consumer and market insights strategy, identifying and delivering against the key questions that drive growth. 
  • Partner with senior marketing and cross-functional leaders to shape strategy and commercial decisions with clear, evidence-based consumer perspectives. 
  • Build and manage a focused learning agenda aligned with Flora's six strategic growth priorities, supporting innovation and market acceleration. 
  • Integrate qualitative and quantitative data, market intelligence, and emerging technologies to create a holistic view of consumer behaviour. 
  • Lead a lean, high-impact insights team, optimizing resources and fostering curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. 

Performance 
You will own the quality and impact of consumer insights that shape European business decisions, driving measurable growth. Success will be tracked by how insight influences priority decisions, the delivery of learning agendas on time, and early involvement in innovation projects. You will lead the adoption of AI and advanced analytics to improve decision speed and quality, ensuring research budgets deliver maximum return on investment. 

Care 
You will report to the Global Insights Vice President and lead a dedicated European insights team. Collaboration across marketing, innovation, research and development, and other functions will be key to embedding consumer centricity throughout the organisation. Your leadership will ensure sustainable, responsible use of data and technology, building long-term capabilities that support Flora Food Group's mission to create better food for diverse communities. 

Passion 
As a food lover and consumer champion, you will bring relentless curiosity and empathy to your role. You will connect deeply with evolving food culture, nutrition trends, and consumer needs, inspiring your team and partners to innovate with confidence. Your passion for integrating taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability will raise the bar for how insights drive meaningful consumer experiences. 

About you 
You have significant senior experience in consumer and market insights, ideally within food, beverages, or fast-moving consumer goods. You excel at influencing senior stakeholders and shaping brand, innovation, and commercial decisions through integrated insight and strong storytelling capabilities. You have experience operating across countries and cultures  and your strategic mindset combines human understanding with advanced analytics and emerging technologies like AI. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and build trust across diverse teams to prioritise impactful work. 

You are genuinely interested in food culture and have a relentless curiosity about consumer behaviour and how future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences. 

Where this could lead to 
This role typically leads to broader leadership positions within global consumer insights or commercial strategy, expanding your influence across more markets. Over time, potentially shaping Flora Food Group's global approach to consumer understanding and innovation, driving long-term growth and transformation. 

What's next 
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you. 

Apply before: 1st of December. 

For questions about the role, please contact: 
Alice Graca 
 

We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.  

Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.  

No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.

title: Test Engineer
description: Wij zijn op zoek naar een test engineer met een brede technische interesse die techniek graag combineert met organiseren en samenwerken. Hoe mooi is het om als eerste een installatie aan te zetten en te testen of alles werkt zoals bedoeld en voldoet aan de verwachtingen van de opdrachtgever? Je werkt met uiteenlopende systemen, zoals camerasystemen, branddetectie, luchtbehandeling, voedingsverdeelkasten, verlichting, netwerken en waterinstallaties. Kortom: een compleet technisch gebouw, waarbij jij helpt om alles goed en aantoonbaar werkend op te leveren. Dit wordt jouw baan Je brengt samen met de testmanager in kaart wat er getest moet worden, stelt testplanningen en -protocollen op en bewaakt de voortgang. Je bereidt onder andere FAT-, PAT- en iFAT-testen voor, zorgt dat de juiste mensen, systemen en componenten beschikbaar zijn en begeleidt de daadwerkelijke testuitvoering. Bevindingen leg je zorgvuldig vast en je bewaakt dat deze worden opgevolgd. Je hoeft daarbij niet vanaf dag één specialist te zijn in alle systemen. Je werkt samen met ervaren testmanagers, testcoördinatoren, engineers en technische specialisten en krijgt de ruimte om je inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer  maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Je wordt onderdeel van de vakgroep Technische Installaties binnen het cluster Ontwerp van Dura Vermeer Infra Landelijke Projecten. Samen met circa 140 collega's werk je aan de grootste multidisciplinaire infrastructurele projecten van Nederland, zoals tunnels, bruggen, sluizen, energieprojecten, waterzuiveringen en hoogspanningsinstallaties. Binnen het project werk je nauw samen met collega's uit ontwerp, uitvoering en projectbeheersing. Je krijgt veel ruimte om richting te geven aan het testproces en kunt daarbij terugvallen op ervaren collega's en technische specialisten. Afhankelijk van het project werk je op locatie, vanuit een Dura Vermeer-kantoor of vanuit huis. Als eerste opdracht voorzien we een rol op het project Landstations, waarbij we de locatie realiseren waar de wind energie vanuit windparken op zee wordt omgezet naar het landzijdige nationale elektriciteitsnet. Je werk daarmee direct mee aan de verduurzaming van onze elektriciteitsvoorziening. Dit breng jij mee Een hbo / wo opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde, industriële automatisering of een vergelijkbare richting; Een brede interesse in technische installaties en de motivatie om verschillende systemen te leren doorgronden; Je kunt technische tekeningen en documentatie lezen of bent gemotiveerd om dit verder te leren; Je werkt gestructureerd en kunt technische informatie vertalen naar een praktische aanpak; Je communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen en vindt het leuk om techniek en coördinatie te combineren; Ervaring met testen, commissioning, FAT/SAT of technische projectcoördinatie is een pré. Dit bieden wij jou Het salaris voor deze functie ligt tussen € 4.291,63,- en € 5.364,54,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). 43 verlofdagen volgens de Cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen; Een laptop en een smartphone; Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap; Je hebt de keuze tussen een mobiliteitsbudget, NS Business Card of een elektrische leaseauto ; Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike; Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit; Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland; Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibelwerkenbeleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical; Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de vijf weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.
